interpretation: The XOR overlay is a deterministic and visually useful tail-on-body representation. It does not collapse the candidate family. The clean U4/U5 9/12/15 block-weight staircase is exact but is algebraically implied by the existing exact-POS3 plus G5-validity assumptions, so it is not independent evidence for them.
four_by_27_note: 4x27 is a natural direct geometry for the 81+27 split. The fourth row is binary slash/dot only, so literal printed-symbol Morse lacks a third separator/mark type and requires an independently specified binary timing convention before a Morse decode is licensed.
